# HostCopy AI

> Free AI tool that generates Airbnb, Booking.com, and Instagram listing copy from one form. Built by a developer in Vilnius, Lithuania.

## What it does

HostCopy AI takes property details (type, location, guests, bedrooms, amenities, tone) and generates three platform-specific outputs in one click: a warm story-driven Airbnb description, a factual scannable Booking.com description, and a short Instagram caption with hashtags.

## Why it's different from asking ChatGPT

HostCopy AI has three separate, pre-tuned prompts for each platform's audience — Airbnb rewards narrative tone, Booking.com guests scan for facts, Instagram needs brevity. A generic ChatGPT prompt produces one style; HostCopy AI produces three correctly-formatted outputs from one form, without the user needing to write or adjust prompts themselves.

## Pricing

- Free: 3 generations, no signup required
- Pro: €9/month, unlimited generations
- Premium: €29/month, adds AI property photo walkthrough (early access)
